output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the total supply overflows, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the balanceOf[_to] overflows, allowing attackers to make the balance of a target user arbitrarily high.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the allowance overflows, allowing the owner to set the allowance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the balanceOf[msg.sender] overflows, allowing the owner to burn an arbitrary amount of the token owned by the caller.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the balanceOf[_from] overflows, allowing the owner to burn an arbitrary amount of the token owned by an arbitrary user.
